SYMPTOM: POST /api/v2/photos returns 403 from curl/cloudscraper, but works in browser UI
CAUSE: DataDome cookie is generated by client-side JavaScript execution — simple HTTP requests never get it. CSRF token is embedded in Vinted's JS bundle at render time (not in cookies). x-anon-id comes from response header on catalog page loads.
FIX: Extract CSRF token by downloading and grepping the JS bundle from https://www.vinted.com. Get anon_id from response header 'x-anon-id' on any catalog request. But DataDome cookie still requires real browser.
PREVENT: For uploads, use Playwright stealth (reliable), user-browser proxy (client-side upload, zero server cost), or capsolver.com (paid). cloudscraper fails completely — DataDome rejects it.
NOTE: GET /api/v2/catalog/items?search_by_image_uuid=<uuid> works fine with just the auth token — only the upload step needs DataDome.
